### CVE-2018-3615
- Assigner: intel | Published: 2018-08-14 | Updated: 2026-05-29 | Max CVSS: 7.3
- CWE: Information Disclosure; CWE-203 CWE-203 Observable Discrepancy
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.3 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Systems with microprocessors utilizing speculative execution and Intel software guard extensions (Intel SGX) may allow unauthorized disclosure of information residing in the L1 data cache from an enclave to an attacker with local user access via a side-channel analysis.

Affected:
- Intel Corporation / Multiple: affected Multiple

### CVE-2018-3639
- Assigner: intel | Published: 2018-05-22 | Updated: 2026-05-29 | Max CVSS: 5.5
- CWE: Information Disclosure; CWE-203 CWE-203 Observable Discrepancy
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 5.5 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial
- Exploit-DB 44695: AMD / ARM / Intel - Speculative Execution Variant 4 Speculative Store Bypass (dos/hardware, 2018-05-22, verified=1)

Systems with microprocessors utilizing speculative execution and speculative execution of memory reads before the addresses of all prior memory writes are known may allow unauthorized disclosure of information to an attacker with local user access via a side-channel analysis, aka Speculative Store Bypass (SSB), Variant 4.

Affected:
- Intel Corporation / Multiple: affected Multiple
